title: A Rat in the Bin
lines: Mom and Sid tip mud and buds in a bin.
The mud and buds rot in the sun.
"Buds rot in a hot bin," said Mom.
A rip is in the bin.
A rat hops in the rip!
"Not in the bin, rat!" said Sid.
Mom and Sid fit a cap on the rip.
The rat can not hop in the bin.
The rat hops up on a pot and naps.
